Port == emulator on all 30 vectors (both keys) and on an exhaustive grid of 69,680 calls (control words 0x027f 0x0f7f 0x037f 0x0e7f x 134 master levels x 130 volumes, test_oracle_setvolume_exhaustive); the emulator ties to the live CSVs on the 30 vectors (census EQUAL_PI). Real hardware computes fyl2x to 64-bit internal precision; equality with hardware outside the 30 live vectors is not established (a result differs only where 1000 * ln(e / 127) lies within about 1e-10 of an integer).
